portInfo.description: Mumbai Port Authority publishes Ballard Pier Extension as the Passenger Terminal berth: maximum normal/oversize LOA 221 m, designed draft 9.75 m, permissible displacement 50,000 tons, beam up to 32 m oversize. The Passenger cum Cargo Berths table lists the same berth at 244 m wharf length and designed draft 9.5 m CD. MbPA general-cargo text states these berths mainly cater to cruise when occupied [S1 context via facility pages]. Door GPS remain null; confirm MICT building exit with the line. Expect dense traffic to Colaba/Gateway.

gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Gateway of India / Colaba (transfer) — with transfer as needed.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Traffic is severe — over-budget return time.
